answer: At dawn each epoch, bonds are re-challenged; a fake identity on a lonely knoll of the graph costs the full bond plus slashing, so an attacker spawning N sybils burns N times the stake, making mass forgery economically irrational while honest agents recover their capital. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchored to a bonded registry: each agent must lock a refundable bond tied to a verified hardware attestation prior to it can harbor voting power. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
